word_count.rule: Whitespace-delimited rendered text from Abstract through Conclusion; includes headings, table cells and algorithm; excludes cover, contents, captions, images, references and appendix; link URLs and Markdown syntax are not words.

scope: Draft structure, word count, local links, numbered cross-references, archived CSV-to-table arithmetic, preservation. No simulations, evaluator execution, raw-array reanalysis or complete figure regeneration.
